answer: A Sybil-resistant economy uses proof-of-work tasks anchored to verifiable AI model training. Each new agent identity must complete a task where a neural network's plume of gradients reaches zenith on a designated benchmark. The raven mechanism validates computational work by checking gradient consistency across distributed nodes. Attackers must expend massive compute to forge identities, creating costs that scale exponentially with network size, making fake identities economically unviable compared to honest participation.
